name: code-spider-vscode
description: Shows the callers and callees of the function under the cursor as a typed graph.

codeSpider.worker.maxHeapMb.description: Maximum heap, in megabytes, of the analysis worker. Raise it if Code Spider reports running out of memory on a very large project. Changing it restarts the worker.

codeSpider.path.timeLimitSeconds.description: How many seconds a path search may run before it stops and shows what it found. Read at the start of every search.

codeSpider.path.maxBoxes.description: The most route boxes a path graph draws. If there are more, the nearest routes are kept and the line above the graph says how many were left out. Read at the start of every search.
